## Frequently Asked Questions

What are the best ClearFeed alternatives in 2026?

The strongest ClearFeed alternatives are eesel AI for AI that plugs into the helpdesk you already run, Unthread and Thena for B2B support in shared Slack channels, Suptask for the cheapest per-seat Slack ticketing, and Ravenna for internal IT and HR. If you would rather the helpdesk stay the system of record, look at Jira Service Management, Zendesk or Freshservice. Our full roundup of AI for Slack support goes wider.

How much does ClearFeed cost? [...] Is there a free ClearFeed alternative?

Nothing in this category is meaningfully free at volume, but the entry points differ a lot. Freshdesk has a free plan, eesel AI gives you $50 of usage with no card, and Suptask starts at $15 per agent. Our roundup of free ticketing systems covers the genuinely no-cost options, and ticketing for small teams covers the cheap ones.

What is the best ClearFeed alternative for Microsoft Teams?

ClearFeed treats Teams as an inbound channel rather than a place agents work, so almost anything beats it here. Ravenna treats Teams as a first-class surface, Thena includes it on its Enterprise tier, and eesel AI answers in Teams the same way it does in Slack. See our guide to AI for Microsoft Teams support and our wider look at AI in Microsoft Teams. [...] ### Our take

Zendesk is right when support is a department rather than a side effect of engineering. It is the wrong answer if you liked ClearFeed because it kept everything in one Slack window, since you would be buying the exact thing ClearFeed exists to spare you. Our Zendesk AI agents guide covers making the AI side work.

## 8. Freshservice

Best for: ITSM buyers who want an autonomous agent without a Pro-tier upgrade.

Freshservice and its sibling Freshdesk are worth a look mainly because of where Freshworks put the AI, which is lower down the stack than most people assume.

results.title: ClearFeed alternative — Threadmaker
results.content:
Threadmaker

# Threadmaker vs ClearFeed

ClearFeed is a Slack-native helpdesk platform — a full support desk with AI agents, ticketing, SLAs, and omnichannel intake (Slack, email, MS Teams, Discord, web chat, portal), where syncing to Jira is one of many integrations. If you're running customer or internal support out of Slack, it's a mature, well-reviewed choice. Threadmaker is a different, narrower tool: it isn't a helpdesk you adopt — it just keeps Jira comments and Slack threads in sync, both ways, for a flat per-user price.

Add Threadmaker to Slack — free for up to 10 users.

## Threadmaker vs ClearFeed: at a glance [...] You just want Jira comments in Slack, both ways — not a helpdesk to adopt, staff, and configure. One job, done deeply.
 Predictable per-user pricing. Free for up to 10 users, then $1.50/user with no cap on sync volume — versus per-ticket billing metered at 250 tickets/month.
 Forge-native. Threadmaker runs on Atlassian's Forge platform and stores no Jira API tokens — a smaller security surface than an external SaaS that holds a copy of your data.
 Works in any channel, including Slack Connect — which ClearFeed's Integrations Edition doesn't cover.
